title: Go n Get It
text: "Go n Get It" is a song by American rapper Ace Hood, released as the second single from his third studio album Blood, Sweat & Tears on June 14, 2011. The song was produced by Lex Luger, and co-written by Hood and Luger. Originally, "Go 'N Get It" was featured on Ace Hood's mixtape, Body Bag Vol. 1.
